content: The selection of continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) devices, including real-time CGM (rtCGM) and intermittently scanned CGM (isCGM), should be customized to meet the specific medical requirements of each individual. This decision must also take into account the person’s daily lifestyle, personal preferences, and level of proficiency with technology. Key considerations include the patient’s ability to effectively self-manage their diabetes, the frequency and intensity of their insulin therapy, and whether they require real-time glucose data to manage their condition. These factors are essential in determining the most appropriate CGM device for the individual.
